decisions.decision: Endpoint is the product edge device, not the research bench node
decisions.rationale: User chose this explicitly; the node must end the track emitting EdgeTelemetryEnvelope packets the existing backend consumes

decisions.decision: Gait/Doppler identification, the M8 noise-model anchor, and simulation comparison are all out of scope
decisions.rationale: User said to drop the research; CSI is developed only as far as presence/movement/rf_disturbance/respiration features

decisions.decision: The 450 Hz CSI gate is a measurement to record, not a blocker
decisions.rationale: It gated gait Doppler, which is out of scope; product features need far less

decisions.decision: Radar UART pins established empirically by cycling candidates rather than trusting the library example
decisions.rationale: The mmWaveKit example targets the C6 and leans on that board's default mapping; GPIO44 carries traffic and GPIO43 is silent

decisions.decision: Radar message semantics cross-validated rather than assumed
decisions.rationale: Message 0x0100 carries the module's own plain-text log which labels the numeric ids; distance was independently confirmed against point-cloud y

decisions.decision: Absent values are transmitted as NaN or an explicit sentinel behind a validity bitmask, never 0
decisions.rationale: docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md forbids zero-filling an unavailable value; the rule starts on the wire in frame.h

decisions.decision: Work split seam is firmware/shared/frame.h; host tooling builds against a synthetic generator with no board attached
decisions.rationale: Lets the host stack be built in parallel with bench work

context_notes: M0-M3 are genuinely done on hardware with measured evidence in firmware/docs/BRINGUP_LOG.md. The single most important finding is that the radar reported a confident 117-119 bpm heart rate off a desk while breathing correctly reported invalid - the two vital fields do not fail the same way, so M8 cannot gate them with one rule. There is an unraised scope concern: the user asked for a fused view detecting body shape, posture, heart rate and breathing. Posture and body shape are not achievable with these parts (MLX90640 gives 6-10 px on a person at 3 m; the radar exposes no dense point cloud), and vitals are uncalibrated consumer-grade estimates that demonstrably fabricate. That needs flagging under section 3 of the brief before any fused viewer is built.
